header: xPlots: rentable plots, set up in a minute.
Apply changes with /xplots reload: everything applies but storage. A bad value falls back to
its default with a warning in the console; xPlots never stops over config. The messages, the
signs' lines and the menus' text are in lang/.

comment: How this plugin's messages look, and the language they're in. shared uses the
setting in plugins/Xena/config.yml, which every Xena plugin reads; anything else is
this plugin's own.
The language players see messages in: auto for each player's own (their client's
language setting), or one language for everyone, such as de or pt-BR.
The language of the console, and of players whose language has no file in lang/.
The look every message shares, used in messages as tags: <prefix>, <highlight>,
<success> and <error>. Colours are names (gray, gold) or hex (#B48CFF), with bold,
italic, underlined, strikethrough or obfuscated if you like: <#B48CFF><bold>.
<prefix> starts the default messages. Make it your server's name, such as
"<dark_gray>[<gradient:#B48CFF:#5EE08A>MyServer</gradient>]</dark_gray> ", or blank for none.
The colour of message text that has no tag of its own.
<highlight>: names and values, such as a player or a speed.
<success>: something turned on or done.
<error>: something refused or turned off.
Every field's settings, unless the field changes one with /xplots field set. Times are
written like 3d, 12h or 1d12h.
What one period of rent costs.
How long one payment of rent lasts.
The most rent that can be paid ahead. A player can pay again while there's room, so a
plot is never lost to a missed window.
Members a new rental can add, besides the owner, who doesn't take a slot.
The most member slots a plot can have, after buying more.
What one more member slot costs.
Put a plot back as it was when it was made, once its rent runs out or it's abandoned.
Anything built in it is lost, items in chests included.
How much of the unused rent abandoning a plot gives back, in percent.
2.0: renew rent on its own for one more period as it runs out (an hour before), from
the owner's balance, online or not, so a plot isn't lost while they're away. Needs an
economy (currency.type: economy); an owner can turn it off for their plot in its menu.
Each renewal is charged once, even across a crash or a restart.
What rent is paid with.
economy uses the server's economy: xMoney's, when it's installed (each payment in its
ledger, with the plot), or any economy plugin's through Vault (EssentialsX, CMI). vault,
1.x's name, is the same. item takes the item below from the player's inventory.
For type: item.
The item's name as players see it, without colours, such as "Coin". Blank takes any
item of the material.
The item's custom model data, for a resource pack's coin. 0 takes any.
How amounts are written: "1 Coin", "5 Coins".
How many plots a player may rent at once. A player with xplots.limit.<n> may rent <n>
instead, the highest they have.
Plot signs. What they say is in lang/ (signs.free, signs.rented, signs.expiring), four
lines each.
A rented plot's sign shows signs.expiring once its rent runs out within this.
The sign placed for each plot: any standing sign, such as dark_oak_sign. Before 1.14, sign.
Where on a plot's front edge its sign stands: middle, left-corner or right-corner, as
seen from the walkway looking at the plot. A field can change it with
/xplots field set <field> sign-position. Signs already placed move with
/xplots field signs <field>.
Which way a sign faces: straight at the walkway, or diagonal: turned 45° out from its
corner, so it reads from both walkways where they cross. Any sign can also be turned
by hand: sneak and right click it with the wand.
The plot menus' items, by their ids. Their titles, names and lore are in lang/ (menus.*).
Fills the empty slots. air leaves them empty.
Clicking a free plot's sign.
Clicking your own plot's sign, or /plots.
/plots with more than one plot.
Adding a member: heads of the players online.
Staff clicking a plot with the wand.
Seconds to stand still before /plots home and /plots warp teleport. xplots.warmup.bypass
skips it. With xTeleport installed, plot homes are also in /homes, with xTeleport's own warmup.
How long putting a plot back may work each tick, in milliseconds. A tick is 50. A small
plot takes a fraction of one.
Where this plugin keeps its data. Read at startup only: restart after changing it.
sqlite keeps everything in one file in the plugin's folder, with nothing to set up.
mysql (or MariaDB) is for networks, or servers with a lot of history.
shared keeps it in the database every Xena plugin can share, set in plugins/Xena/config.yml.
Put in front of every table's name, so plugins and servers can share one database.
Only for type: mysql.
Extra connection settings, as in a JDBC URL: useSSL=true&serverTimezone=UTC.
The connections used to read, beside the one that writes.
How many: 0 picks for the database (1 for SQLite, 2 for MySQL). More helps only a
MySQL server that many reads wait on.
Telling you when a newer version is out: in the console, and to players with
<plugin>.admin.update when they join. Asks Modrinth once a day, off the server's threads,
sending only the plugin's version, the platform and the Minecraft version.
Whether to ask at all.
Which releases to hear of: release, beta (betas and releases) or alpha (everything).
